races.paceDynamic: Rocky's Howya represents the lone confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the start in this eleven-runner field. With no obvious pace pressure, he can settle into a comfortable rhythm through the early stages, creating a sustainable tempo that won't burn out the field early. The prominent runners like Lightkeeper, Jerandme, and You Done Well will track him in behind, while the hold-up horses including Woodstream Lad, Solly Attwell, God Of Thunder, and Spinning Web will rely on the pace developing late. This measured tempo strongly favours the prominent and hold-up horses who can time their challenges, as Rocky's Howya may lack the tactical pressure needed to maximize his front-running effectiveness.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prosper
scenarios.trigger: If Rocky's Howya sets an uncontested lead allowing patient types to close strongly
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace sets up perfectly for closers who can produce late kicks. Woodstream Lad and Solly Attwell benefit most from this tactical setup with their proven finishing ability.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace remains steady but prominent runners can position perfectly behind Rocky's Howya
scenarios.body: Lightkeeper and Jerandme can track the leader and strike at the optimal moment when the pace lifts. Their tactical positioning gives them first run on the field before the hold-up horses can respond.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Rocky's Howya's recent winning streak continues and he maintains his strong jumping rhythm
scenarios.body: His excellent recent form and sustainable pace style could prove too much if he jumps accurately throughout. The lack of pace pressure allows him to control the race completely from pillar to post.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Rocky's Howya stops quickly and prominent runners also fail to sustain their effort
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish between whoever has energy left in the closing stages. This chaotic finish could suit an outsider who has been held up throughout and avoided the earlier pace.

watchPoints.text: Rocky's Howya could steal this if he jumps fluently and maintains his winning momentum unchallenged
Woodstream Lad's hold-up style perfectly suits this pace setup but needs the race to develop properly
Lightkeeper carries strong ratings but the long absence creates uncertainty about current fitness levels
Solly Attwell represents the in-form Collins stable and showed renewed vigor in his recent Clonmel third
God Of Thunder possesses the highest official rating but his recent refusal and trainer's poor form statistics raise red flags

races.paceDynamic: Springhill Warrior, Tomthescaffolder, and Welcome Back will ensure a genuine gallop from the start, with three confirmed front-runners in a 17-runner field creating sustained pace pressure. The strong tempo will stretch the field early and test stamina reserves over this demanding 2m3½f trip at Clonmel. Many of the hold-up horses carry fade-in-finish warnings (China Grill, Jalfrezi, Akako, Ajp Falco, Whatdoyoucallhim), suggesting they struggle when pace burns off their finishing kick. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with proven stamina who can track the pace without being detached.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Favours Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners maintain honest fractions throughout
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will expose the many hold-up horses with finishing concerns, while prominent racers like Minella Diamond can track the leaders and have more left in reserve. Those racing handy avoid the sprint finish that several runners struggle with.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: Welcome Back or Springhill Warrior could exploit their class edge by dictating terms and having enough left when others fade. The strong early pace suits their front-running style if they can find another gear.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late Kick
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too fast early and come back dramatically
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish favouring the fresher hold-up horses, though many carry fade warnings that make this scenario risky. Only the best finishers without specific stamina concerns can capitalise.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Chaos Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If jumping errors or interference disrupts the pace scenario
scenarios.body: A scrappy race develops where the lightly-raced unknowns could benefit from avoiding trouble while more exposed runners struggle. Form often goes out the window in these circumstances.

races.paceDynamic: Ixigreczed will lead from the start with no other confirmed front runners in this 19-runner field, giving him an uncontested advantage early. Kilbarry Ce Ce and Thewaybackhome will track prominently behind the leader, while the vast majority including Whiskey Serenade, Sarah's Express, and Hob's Angel will settle in midfield and rear positions. The large field and lack of pace pressure means Ixigreczed can dictate a steady gallop until the business end, when the hold-up horses will need to find racing room in a congested finish. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will hit the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Ixigreczed maintains his early advantage without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The confirmed front runner gets an easy lead and can quicken when it matters, while the mass of hold-up horses struggle for clear runs in the closing stages. Prominent trackers get first run at the leader but may lack the sustained pace to reel him in over this staying trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Kilbarry Ce Ce and Thewaybackhome can get first run at the tiring leader
scenarios.body: The two prominent runners avoid traffic problems and can sustain their challenge better than the hold-up horses who face a wall of horses ahead. Their tactical positioning proves decisive as they have clear sight of the leader throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If one of the rear runners gets a clear passage through the field
scenarios.body: A well-handicapped hold-up horse like Whiskey Serenade or Sarah's Express finds racing room and their superior turn of foot tells in the final furlong. The majority of their rivals remain trapped behind horses as the pace quickens.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the finish becomes extremely congested with multiple fallers or interference
scenarios.body: A horse with an alert jockey who can switch wide or find an inside gap capitalizes on the misfortune of others. The race falls apart tactically and an unconsidered runner sneaks through for place money.

races.paceDynamic: Amron Diamond is the sole confirmed front-runner in this 19-runner handicap hurdle, meaning he can dictate terms without early pressure. The prominent runners Mollys Dolly, Bite That, Listenheretomejack, and Glendine Billy will settle just behind but are unlikely to press aggressively early given the trip. This creates a moderate pace that should quicken from the back straight as the large field of hold-up horses including Listentomewillya, Finnicky Filly, Old Kenmare, and Tedworth begin their challenges. The tactical verdict clearly favours hold-up horses who can save ground and finish strongly, as they won't need to overcome a punishing early gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Amron Diamond leads uncontested through moderate early fractions
scenarios.body: The large contingent of hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks from the back straight. Horses like Tedworth, Old Kenmare, and Finnicky Filly can time their runs perfectly without energy-sapping early positioning battles.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Benefit
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate pace allows prominent runners to stay closer than usual
scenarios.body: Horses like Bite That and Listenheretomejack can press forward earlier knowing they haven't been softened up by fierce early tempo. Their tactical positioning advantage over the hold-up brigade proves decisive in a steadily-run contest.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Kicks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Amron Diamond gets such soft fractions that he retains stamina reserves
scenarios.body: The front-runner can inject pace approaching the final flight when the closers are still too far back. Despite his fading tendency, the light weight and uncontested lead give him every chance to exploit the field positioning.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Into Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If Amron Diamond goes too slowly and the field bunches entering the straight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge where the best raw speed matters more than tactical positioning. This neutralizes the hold-up horses' advantage and creates a messy finish where anything can happen.

watchPoints.text: Amron Diamond's early fractions will dictate the entire race shape - if he goes too fast or too slow it changes everything

races.paceDynamic: Crossing The Bar will lead from the start with his confirmed front-running style, setting a sustainable gallop over this staying trip without pressure from other genuine pace-setters. The prominent runners Penny Express, Ned In The Park, Le Kap, Colleen Danu, Ishan, and Brianna Lily will track behind in a pack, while the hold-up horses Oh So Charming, Arctic Flame, Le Diablo, Imarajan, and Speakasyoufind will be held towards the rear. With only one true leader and a large field of 12, this creates an ideal tactical scenario for the hold-up horses who can exploit the inevitably strong pace over this demanding distance when the prominent pack comes under pressure from the home turn.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Crossing The Bar sets his usual honest pace and the prominent group gets strung out from 3f out
scenarios.body: The hold-up specialists will have perfectly timed runs from off the pace as the early pace takes its toll. Arctic Flame and Le Diablo are ideally positioned to exploit this scenario with their proven closing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker wins
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes moderate and one of the tracking group can quicken from a handy position
scenarios.body: Penny Express or Ned In The Park could dictate from a prominent position and have enough left to repel late challengers. Their tactical positioning gives them first strike on the leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner stays
scenarios.trigger: If Crossing The Bar gets an easy lead and the field comes too late
scenarios.body: His stamina could prove decisive if he's not pressured early and can dictate fractions to suit. The long absence is a concern but his front-running style suits solo leadership.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Crossing The Bar goes very slowly and it becomes a sprint from the last
scenarios.body: The race would lose its staying test and become tactical. This would completely change the complexion but seems unlikely given his honest style.

races.paceDynamic: Expound sits as the only confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the start with sustainable fractions. Behind him, five horses (Sense Of Occasion, Tingarran Express, Lady Doyanne, Theflyingbee, Tir Og) all want prominent positions, creating inevitable traffic problems approaching the business end. The hold-up quartet (Ballycashin, Eye Of A Tiger, Sonny May, Takarengo) will need gaps to materialize from 2 out. This setup strongly favours the leader Expound and any prominent runners who can secure clean jumping room early, as the pace won't be punishing but the traffic will be brutal for those held up.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leader Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Expound jumps fluently and the prominent brigade get in each other's way from 3 out.
scenarios.body: Expound's uncontested lead becomes decisive as the traffic-snarled prominent runners compromise each other's momentum. The sustained pace suits his stamina while chaos erupts behind.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Royal
scenarios.trigger: If the five prominent runners maintain clean jumping and challenge Expound from 2 out.
scenarios.body: The pace lifts dramatically as multiple challengers engage, turning into a stamina test that favours the classiest prominent runner. Traffic clears but energy gets sapped.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion creates significant interference and gaps open late.
scenarios.body: The early scrimmaging compromises the prominent runners' chances while Ballycashin and Eye Of A Tiger get dream splits in the straight. Fresh legs prevail over compromised pace-pressers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Expound's 273-day absence tells and he weakens quickly from 3 out.
scenarios.body: The leader's capitulation leaves a vacuum that mid-division runners exploit, with Chanceawetmorning best placed to inherit. Elliott's runner gets the perfect trip as favourites falter.

watchPoints.text: Watch for early interference in the prominent positions as five runners converge - any faller here derails multiple chances
Monitor Expound's jumping rhythm early - if his 273-day break shows in his fluency, the race dynamic changes completely
Eye Of A Tiger and Ballycashin need watching for late movement - if gaps don't appear by 2 out they're done
Check Tingarran Express's early position - 77-day gap may see connections drop him in further than usual
Watch for Chanceawetmorning tracking the pace rather than making it - Elliott may have him perfectly placed for the chaos
